headline: Amgen (AMGN) Faces Patient Data Breach And Tavneos Review Risk
summary: Amgen (NasdaqGS:AMGN) has reported a major cybersecurity breach that exposed sensitive patient health information. At the same time, regulators are reviewing the clinical data supporting its rare inflammatory disease drug Tavneos, following the retraction of a pivotal publication. Together, the data breach and questions over Tavneos data raise regulatory, reputational, and operational risks for Amgen.
